title: Jewel Toned Moroccan Chwinamul Rfissa
description: A cultured and chewy Moroccan dish featuring chwinamul, braised in a flavorful broth, served in a copper mug, low in calories and rich in nutrients, perfect for a special occasion.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Add the cumin and coriander and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the chwinamul, vegetable broth, lemon juice, salt, and black pepper, and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
Serve the rfissa in a copper mug, garnished with fresh herbs, if desired.
Let it cool slightly before serving.
Serve with crusty bread or over rice, if desired.
Garnish with a sprinkle of cumin and coriander, if desired.
